draft.title: Branding and digital marketing
card: Brand
the name, logo, look and reputation that make a business easy to recognise. A strong brand also helps customers trust it.
Social media
a business can post on platforms such as Instagram or TikTok to reach many people and talk with customers directly.
Influencers
people with a large online following who recommend products. Their followers may trust them more than a plain advertisement.
Targeted ads
online ads shown only to chosen groups, such as people of a certain age or who live in a certain area. This helps a business reach likely buyers.
draft.remember: A strong brand is recognised and trusted, and digital tools carry its message to chosen customers.

a.q: Which result shows that a business has built a strong brand?
opts: Shoppers recognise its logo and trust its products
Shoppers see its ads more often than any rival's
Shoppers can buy its products at many different stores
Shoppers find its products cheaper than any rival's
a.why: A strong brand means customers recognise the business and trust it. Seeing ads often can help with recognition, but it does not show that customers trust the business.
a.clue: Think about recognising and trusting, not how often people see ads.

b.q: Zoe runs a skate shop in Geelong. She wants to reach teenagers who live nearby, and she pays for online ads shown only to people aged 13 to 18 in Geelong. What is this an example of?
opts: A targeted online ad
An influencer recommendation
A social media conversation
A brand logo and name
b.why: The ads are shown only to a chosen group by age and area, which makes them targeted ads. An influencer is a person with a following who recommends a product, and Zoe has not used one.
b.clue: Look at who sees the ad and how that group was chosen.

a.best: Shoppers recognise its logo and trust its products

problems.detail: The clue ('Think about recognising and trusting, not how often people see ads') names the exact words of the right option and rules out its strongest distractor, so a student can answer without knowing the idea.
